title: [UE-0.27] Workbench in the game build (GDD 1.3 §12 step 20, MVP 8)
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Gameplay Dev

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Public/Harness/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Harness/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Harness/**`, `pipeline/qa/test-map.md`, `pipeline/qa/baked.json`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Public/Harness/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Harness/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Harness/**`, `pipeline/qa/test-map.md`, `pipeline/qa/baked.json`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.3, UE-0.5, UE-0.26

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

none (no later card lists it in After)

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The 0.25-0.26 harness code is ported into `Harness/` with one flag per manifest record that has a flag, each at its manifest default: `UmbrellaElla.Harness.FlagsMatchManifest` passes, and FAILS once with one default flipped on purpose (pasted)
- [ ] `UmbrellaElla.Harness.DisabledDependencyRejectedWithLog` and `UmbrellaElla.Harness.World.FlagsOffBaselineUnchanged` pass (QA-10); the QA-10 row in `pipeline/qa/test-map.md` is set to merged with this card's number
- [ ] Preset T-01 from `pipeline/qa/presets.json` loads and logs 1 `TestPresetLoaded` line with build, manifest version and seed (pasted)
- [ ] Debug-only (D-new-workbench-debug): panel, sliders, presets, scenarios, overlay and export sit inside `#if UMBRELLAELLA_WORKBENCH`; `IsFeatureEnabled` stays in every build. Each flag default and each tunable default carries its `// bake:` marker. On the submission package `tools\ue\smoke.ps1` passes with `workbench=0` and no `WORKBENCH_ON` line; on a `package.ps1 -Workbench` package `-Workbench` shows the panel and logs `WORKBENCH_ON debug=1` (pasted)
- [ ] First bake: T-01 exported from the workbench, `python3 tools/bake_preset.py bake Saved/Workbench/config-T-01.json` (diff pasted, values unchanged) writes `pipeline/qa/baked.json` for the features coded so far (it lists the rest as `not marked yet`; the G4 bake card covers them, `pipeline/checklists/tuning.md`), and `bake_preset.py check --preset T-01` prints PASS; it FAILS once with one marked default edited by hand (both pasted)
- [ ] `python3 tools/module_check.py` prints `module_check: 0 problem(s)` (rule M included), pasted

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
